description:
Her full name is Asuka Shikinami Langley.
A native of Germany and the pilot of Evangelion Unit Two,
her competitive nature and straightforward personality makes it difficult for her to be bested by people around her.

lines.text: Helping the stupid masses is the duty of the elite.

Is the food in this world called "Splendamin"?
I can't believe you're making me eat that.

The air is terrible.
Is it because we're underground?

Do you also have game consoles here?
The handheld ones you can bring anywhere.
I'll have to go through this alone, anyway.
Just wait, Unit Two. We'll be able to go back soon.

Are you a complete idiot?
Don't just stand there. Do something!

How long are you going to keep me waiting?
What an idiot.

Where can I find a quiet place...?
I guess there's none.

Raptures have invaded, and you're acting like this?
Don't you have a sense of urgency?!
Houses that have rooms without locks? Unbelievable.

I am Asuka Shikinami Langley, the pilot of Evangelion Unit Two.
Remember that.
Now you have no choice but to acknowledge my talent, right?
That's a given. I'm a genius, after all.
I'm the cream of the crop.

Is this item from this world?
Interesting.
I'll still do well even if you don't give me such things.

A gift?
Fine, I'll take it.

Nikkes who fight for mankind...
Wherever you go, it's always the outstanding ones who get the short end of the stick.

So the Ark is akin to mankind's last paradise.
Hmm, I guess things are better in our world.

So, Raptures are the main villains in this world?
The equivalents in my world are called Angels.
If you think about who's better, the answer is obvious.
I'm listening.
Let's move out.
Brace yourself!
I can take them on alone!
Quit struggling!
Think you can challenge me?!
Reloading!
Oh, come on!
Stay where you are!
It's my turn now!
Let's end this!
Go go go!
I got it!
Out of my way!
Take this!
Tsk!
Urgh...
This is...!
Darn it!
That was a cakewalk.

How much longer do I have to stay in this world?
It's so boring!

Today's condition? 
Are you an idiot? It's perfect, of course.

School, huh... Will that be okay?
Wouldn't it be a problem if an outsider gets the top score?

You did a great job.
... What. Are you unhappy about my greeting?

You always seem busy.
Do you feel happier when you're with others?
What is that idiot Shinji doing now?
Hey! What are you doing? Are you even listening?

Hey! You're just going to leave me standing here?
Are you an idiot or something?

That entire thing that looks like the sky is a screen?
Whoa, that's huge.

Don't you all think you're a little too relaxed?
And you people have no sense of security.
I can't imagine living in a house where doors don't lock.

By the way, about this test plug suit... 
I like the red color, but don't you think it's too revealing?
That's the difference in abilities.
Don't be surprised. This is normal.
Good. It's time to update the top score.
What's this? A gift for me?
You don't have to butter me up. I'll do my job well regardless.
Heh, the things in this world aren't that different, after all.

Nikkes don't really look that different from humans.
I wouldn't have known if you didn't tell me.

So the Ark is a replication of the surface?
Awesome. It doesn't feel like the underground at all.

The probability of encountering Raptures on the surface within an hour is 100%?
What the heck? Doesn't that mean there are infinite encounters?
For being a genius!
I know.
I will take the lead.
Come on. Bring it on!
You eyesores!
I alone can wipe you all out!
Ha, easy-peasy!
Reloading! Cover me!
Getting better at this!
I'll be there soon. Wait for me!
Here I come!
Well, that's not bad.
Heyaaaaaaa!
That was a piece of cake!
Next!
Great!
Watch out...!
Damn it...!
Seriously...!?
Tsk...! How troublesome...!
This is the inevitable outcome.
